name: SecSight - Kill Process
description: 终止进程 — SecSight 契约: execution_argument.target = {hostname, pid, process_name}。

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
payload = json.loads($exec)
t = payload.get('target', {})
return {'hostname': t.get('hostname'), 'pid': t.get('pid'), 'process_name': t.get('process_name'), 'case_id': payload.get('case_id')}

actions.name: kill_via_wazuh_ar
actions._comment: Wazuh: PUT /active-response {command: 'kill-process', arguments: [pid]} | 或 osquery + SSH

_secsight_contract.note: 无回滚 — 进程已终止无法恢复,依赖 DFIR 取证在此动作前完成
